reply.thought: Checking refunds status and then computing net balances per customer via ledger before recording payouts.

Refunds list matches applied refunds for orders 130 and 133; order 134 refund is not applied. Proceed to pay customers their net balances using net_balance tool.

Now retrieve net balance for cobalt to complete payouts.
Refunds applied appear complete for this batch (only orders 130 and 133 have refunds applied, none for 134). Net balances computed from ledger; record one payout per customer accordingly.

All customer payouts recorded for this batch using net balances after verifying refunds applied.
